messages:
Sam: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: merged the jwt-rotation PR (https://git/repo/PR/215), hotfixed header parsing in the gateway, and added a short smoke test for auth. Blockers: still seeing occasional 429 bursts from dedicated pools when auth fails and retries stack. Today: watch canary, add metric to trace retry chains, and follow up w/ infra. cc @Maya @Jo
Maya: Heads up — I dug into ratepolicy logs overnight, and ~70% of 429s align with retry storms from our Python SDK (no backoff). I'll open a small SDK PR to add exponential backoff + jitter. That should smooth the burst.
Jo: Rolled out header-parsing patch to staging at 03:10. It removed a couple of malformed-request 401s. Still seeing 429s after that, so prob orthogonal.
Kevin: I built a quick grafana panel for retry chains and added counter for "auth_retry_attempt". Panel link: https://grafana/rdw/retries. Early view shows spikes at 02:58 and 03:12 — correlates with canary deploys.
Priya: Reviewed Sam's jwt-rotation PR — left two tiny comments about test coverage and a missing env var in the dockerfile. Will approve after tests pass.
deploy-bot: canary deploy rwd-gateway@canary succeeded (commit abc123) — 03:15 UTC :white_check_mark:
Sam: Thanks — Priya can you paste the failing test output after CI? I'll patch the env var.
Priya: CI failure was just flakiness on auth timeouts, attaching the snippet:
```
Error: Timeout waiting for token endpoint (5000ms)
Call stack: gateway -> auth-proxy -> token-svc
```
I increased timeout in test to 8s and re-ran; passing now.
Maya: Quick thought — while SDK backoff helps, let's also add a short token-cache grace (50ms) in the gateway to absorb back-to-back calls from edge clients. Small config change, low risk.
Kevin: Agreed. I'll add a feature flag "token_cache_grace_ms" default 0 and set to 50 for canary pools. If metrics look good we can flip to prod.
Sam: Plan: 1) Maya SDK PR (backoff+jitter) 2) Kevin add grace flag + dashboard 3) Priya + Sam finalize jwt-rotation tests 4) Monitor 24h for 429 reductions. If no improvement, escalate to infra for pool autoscaling tweak.
Jo: I'll keep an eye on logs and post any new spikes here. If someone wants pairing on the SDK PR ping me.
Maya: ping @Jo for SDK review once I open PR. ETA for PR: today EOD.
Sam: Great — no other blockers from me. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Kevin: Minor FYI: I scheduled an alert that fires if 429 rate > 1% for > 10m on dedicated pools. Should catch regressions early.
Priya: LGTM on the monitoring plan. I'll queue up the CR to bump test timeouts in CI to reduce flakiness.
Sam: Perfect. Closing the loop — will post a short summary in #incidents if things improve/deteriorate.
